text: Mizuno Corporation (美津濃株式会社) is a listed company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange with securities code 8022, per the header of its FY2027 first-quarter financial report filed on 7 August 2026.
short: Mizuno Corporation is a listed company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, code 8022.
